A lens: a member's estimate of a shared estimand, with its declarations

Source: R/lens.R
quorum_lens.Rd

A lens: a member's estimate of a shared estimand, with its declarations

Usage

quorum_lens(
  name,
  member,
  fit,
  shares,
  expresses = "linear",
  kind = "parameters",
  scope = function(spec) TRUE
)

lens(...)

Arguments

name

Single string, unique within a quorum.

member

Single string naming the package the estimate comes from.

fit

A function (spec, data, ...) returning a quorum_draws() or a quorum_abstention().

shares

Named character vector over the components sampler, objective, priors and data_prep; two lenses that name the same value for a component share it, and the independence ledger counts it.

expresses

Character subset of linear, plateau, threshold, nonmonotone: the response shapes the lens can express.

kind

One of "parameters" or "response_curve".

scope

A function (spec) returning TRUE inside the lens's scope and a quorum_abstention() outside it.

...

Passed to the quorum_lens constructor.

Value

A quorum_lens S7 object.
